changes.text: EgoForce: about 2,000 h of bimanual human demonstrations (40k episodes, 1,000 tasks, 1,000 demonstrators) with TouchTronix gloves of 5 x 12 fingertip and 60 palm taxels per hand, calibrated to newtons, plus head stereo and two wrist cameras; data marked 'Coming Soon' on the project page.
FACT: force-action-track policy for two Sharpa Wave hands that predicts future fingertip force while refining actions, pretrained on EgoForce and 100 h of T-Rex; code announced.

PhysWord: NVIDIA policy that predicts atomic action words aligned with future visual and tactile latents, with one tactile token per Sharpa Wave hand, pretrained with T-Rex Sharpa data in a 7,400 h mix; code announced.

TransDex: visuo-tactile diffusion policy for a 16-DoF hand with PaXini 12x6 fingertip and 10x6 pad arrays, pretrained to reconstruct transparent-object point clouds, 83% average on 3 tasks (RA-L 2026); code on GitHub without a license.
AET-TacNet: autoencoder-transformer that infers hand touch from EMG and kinematics (NRMSE 0.032) on reaching, pouring, screwing and feeding (IEEE TII 2026); closed access, no code statement.
EgoTactile: Open-X-Tactile conversion HustleHard/EgoTactile-OXT (767 clips, 314,100 frames, 63 object zarr archives, 3.5 GB, CC BY-NC 4.0) linked as a derived release.
EgoExplorer: second repository InternRobotics/EgoExplorer-oxt (zarr, 25.5 GB, manual Hugging Face gate) linked as a derived release.

PX OmniSharing DB: AdvDex paper added to sources; it describes OmniShare (over 10k h, 168k trajectories, 721 objects, 14 views, Hall-effect tactile glove), which matches the sample's glove and cameras but states no release.
